question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"coat."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • **"Coat" **is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank. • The word **"coat"** refers to a piece of clothing worn over other clothes to keep warm or dry. (ठंड से बचने के लिए अन्‍य कपड़ों के ऊपर पहना जाने वाला वस्‍त्र; कोट) • **Example**: *Put your **coat**__ on—it’s cold outside.* • The correct answer is Option 1. • **Correct passage**: ......Suddenly another man came in with a __**coat**__ just like Mr. Smith's. "I am sorry," said the man , "I made a mistake.......​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Packet**: a small package or bundle of goods (e.g. a packet of crisps). (छोटा डिब्‍बा, थैली आदि जिसमें किसी वस्‍तु को बेचने के लिए बंद किया जाता है; पैकेट) • **Box**: a container with a flat base and sides, typically square or rectangular and having a lid (e.g. a shoe box). (प्रायः ढक्‍कनदार बक्‍सा; संदूक़) • **Envelope**: a flat paper container with a sealable flap, used to enclose a letter or document. (पत्र का लिफ़ाफ़ा) 4b:Tc39, The correct answer is **"no."**
